_comment: Robot 2 (192.168.1.118), release v20 = commit 565e69b, tree-stamp verified in place.
⚠️ NOT VALID FOR A LIVE RUN YET. --calibration, --camera-rectify and --axis-profile
below all point at PLACEHOLDER files measured on ROBOT 1. They are here so the seam
can be exercised -- status, checkpoints, and a run that is refused for the right
reason -- not because they describe this robot. Replace all three with robot 2's own
measurements before any live run. See whitepaper A19 for what borrowed intrinsics cost.
launch_prefix authenticates by key and is PUBLISHED in get_capabilities, so no
password appears here. BatchMode=yes makes ssh fail fast instead of hanging on a
heading_servo_flag is 'modern': this tree's mappo_drive.py defines --heading-servo,
and the smoke run on 2026-09-01 passed '--heading-servo goal' to it successfully.
--state-bind 127.0.0.1 because jy_exe on this robot sends state to localhost; the run
happens ON the robot, so localhost is correct and survives any address change.
label: Lite3 robot 2 (v20, PLACEHOLDER calibration)
